text: Steps from the Old Port and every restaurant we wanted. The staff remembered our names by day two.
Great location, wish we'd known parking was a block away in a paid garage. Rooms were spotless.
Booked through Expedia and the hotel had no record of us at check-in. Took 40 minutes to sort out. Location is good though.
The blueberry pancakes alone are worth the stay. Walkable to everything in the Old Port.
Comfortable beds, friendly front desk. Check-in isn't until 4 PM which we didn't realise, so we waited in the lobby with bags.
Breakfast was excellent, the pancakes especially. Perfect base for exploring the Old Port on foot.
Decent stay. Parking situation was confusing, no instructions anywhere before arrival.
Staff were lovely and the location can't be beaten.
